theorems.name: Submission.dor_ims_support_of_massOn_eq
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → (∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = μ W) → T.support = U ∩ μ.support
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
